On · shows profit or loss on new offers

Picksmart can read the fare and distances on a ride offer in Uber Driver and show the estimated profit or loss in a small badge at the top of the screen.

It uses Android's accessibility service to read the text on the offer only. It never taps, accepts or declines anything. What it reads stays on this phone: it is not saved, logged or sent anywhere.

When an offer closes, a notification asks whether you took it. Tapping it fills in a trip for you to check; nothing is saved until you tap Save.

Ride apps may not allow other apps to read their screens. Using this could get your driver account warned or blocked. Use it at your own risk.

The result is an estimate from your vehicle's rates. Always check before you accept.
A rising chime for a profit, a falling one for a loss. Plays at the notification volume, and not when the phone is on silent.
